name: xArm 6 — Production Readiness Test Suite
description: Comprehensive test checklist for validating the xArm 6 SiLA 2 server prior to production deployment. Covers TCP connection, motion control, gripper operations, error handling, and physical hardware tests. Tests can be run in Simulation mode (no hardware) or Real mode (requires robotic arm).

categories.name: Communication & Connection
categories.description: TCP connection, IP validation, reconnection robustness

tests.name: Connect in simulation mode
tests.description: Connect to the simulated arm. Verifies Connect succeeds and returns simulated firmware version.

tests.name: Connect to real arm
tests.description: Connect to the arm via TCP. Verifies connection succeeds and firmware version is returned.

tests.name: Connect with invalid IP
tests.description: Attempt to connect with a non-existent IP address. Should return a CommunicationError, not crash.

tests.name: Disconnect cleanly
tests.description: Disconnect from the arm.

tests.name: Reconnect after disconnect
tests.description: Disconnect then immediately reconnect. Tests connection state handling.

tests.name: Command while disconnected
tests.description: Send a command (GoHome) while not connected. Should return NotConnected error.

categories.name: Simulation Mode Switching
categories.description: SimulationController mode switching and observable property updates

tests.name: Start simulation mode
tests.description: Start simulation mode and verify the IsSimulated property updates.

tests.name: Stop simulation mode
tests.description: Stop simulation mode and verify the IsSimulated property updates.

tests.name: Mode switch disconnects active connection
tests.description: Connect in simulation mode, then stop simulation. Connection should be dropped.

categories.name: Motion Control
categories.description: Absolute and relative positioning, speed limits, home position

tests.name: SetPosition absolute move
tests.description: Move to an absolute position. Verifies SetPosition succeeds.

tests.name: SetRelativePosition incremental move
tests.description: Move relative to current position. Verifies SetRelativePosition succeeds.

tests.name: GoHome returns to home position
tests.description: Move to home position. Verifies GoHome succeeds.
tests.expected: GoHome succeeds, CurrentPosition updates to home

tests.name: SetPosition while not connected
tests.description: Attempt to move without connecting first. Should return NotConnected error.

tests.name: SetPosition with minimum speed (1 mm/s)
tests.description: Move at minimum speed. Verifies speed limit is enforced.

tests.name: SetPosition with maximum speed (1000 mm/s)
tests.description: Move at maximum speed. Verifies speed limit is enforced.

tests.name: SetPosition with speed > 1000 (validation)
tests.description: Attempt to move with speed above maximum. Should return error or clamp to max.

tests.name: SetGripperPosition open (850)
tests.description: Open the gripper to maximum position. Verifies SetGripperPosition succeeds.

tests.name: SetGripperPosition close (0)
tests.description: Close the gripper to minimum position. Verifies SetGripperPosition succeeds.

tests.name: SetGripperPosition partial (400)
tests.description: Set gripper to a partial position. Verifies intermediate positions work.

tests.name: SetGripperPosition while not connected
tests.description: Attempt to control gripper without connecting first. Should return NotConnected error.

categories.name: Error Handling
categories.description: Error clearing, emergency stop, and error recovery

tests.name: ClearErrors clears error state
tests.description: Clear any existing errors. Verifies ClearErrors succeeds.

tests.name: EmergencyStop halts motion
tests.description: Trigger emergency stop. Verifies EmergencyStop succeeds and ArmState updates.

tests.name: EmergencyStop while not connected
tests.description: Attempt to trigger emergency stop without connecting first. Should return NotConnected error.

categories.name: Physical Hardware Tests
categories.description: Tests requiring physical interaction with the robotic arm. The test runner automates setup and commands while prompting the user for physical actions.

tests.name: GoHome motion verification
tests.description: Command the arm to move to home position. Verify motion is smooth and position is correct.
tests.expected: Arm moves to home position smoothly without errors

steps.message: Clear the workspace around the arm. Ensure there are no obstacles in the motion path.
Did the arm move smoothly to the home position without errors or collisions?

tests.name: Absolute position move
tests.description: Command the arm to move to a specific absolute position. Verify motion and final position.

steps.message: Clear the workspace. The arm will move to position X=300, Y=0, Z=200.
Did the arm reach the target position accurately? Check the position display in the WebUI.

tests.name: Relative position move
tests.description: Command the arm to move relative to its current position. Verify incremental motion.
tests.expected: Arm moves by the specified delta

steps.message: The arm will move +50mm in the X direction relative to home.
Did the arm move approximately 50mm in the X direction from home?

tests.name: Gripper open and close cycle
tests.description: Test gripper operation by opening and closing. Verify gripper motion.
tests.expected: Gripper opens fully then closes fully

steps.message: Watch the gripper. It will open to maximum, then close to minimum.
Did the gripper open fully?
Did the gripper close fully?

tests.name: Emergency stop during motion
tests.description: Start a long motion, then trigger emergency stop. Verify the arm halts immediately.
tests.expected: Arm stops immediately, no coasting or overshoot

steps.message: After clicking Continue, the arm will start a slow motion. Trigger EmergencyStop while it's moving.
Did the arm stop immediately when EmergencyStop was triggered?

tests.name: Pick and place workflow
tests.description: Execute a complete pick-and-place sequence. Verify all motions and gripper actions.
tests.expected: Arm successfully picks object at source and places at target

steps.message: Place a small object at position X=300, Y=100, Z=50 (approximate). The arm will attempt to pick it and move it to X=300, Y=-100, Z=50.
Did the arm successfully pick the object from the source and place it at the target?
steps.fail_label: No, failed to pick or place

categories.name: WebUI Integration
categories.description: Tests for the React WebUI, SSE streaming, and user interface correctness

tests.name: Current position display updates
tests.description: Verify the WebUI displays the current arm position and updates in real-time.
tests.expected: Position display updates after each motion command

steps.message: Open the xArm 6 WebUI in your browser. Watch the position display during the following commands.
Is the current position displayed in the WebUI?
Did the position display update to show X≈300, Y≈0, Z≈200?

tests.name: Arm state indicator
tests.description: Verify the WebUI displays the arm state (idle, moving, error, etc.).

steps.message: Open the xArm 6 WebUI. Watch the arm state indicator during the following commands.
Is the arm state displayed (e.g., 'Idle', 'Moving', 'Error')?
Did the state change during motion (e.g., from Idle to Moving and back)?

tests.name: SIM/REAL badge accuracy
tests.description: Toggle simulation mode and verify the badge updates in the WebUI.
tests.expected: Badge accurately reflects current mode after each switch

steps.message: Open the xArm 6 WebUI. The server should be in simulation mode. Verify the 'SIM' badge is visible (blue).
Is the SIM badge visible and blue?
Did the badge change to 'REAL' (orange/red)?
Did the badge change back to 'SIM' (blue)?

categories.name: Lock Controller
categories.description: Server locking and unlocking with token validation

tests.name: Lock and unlock server
tests.description: Lock the server with a token, then unlock it.

tests.name: Lock when already locked
tests.description: Lock the server, then try to lock again with a different token.
tests.expected: Second lock attempt returns ServerAlreadyLocked error

tests.name: Unlock with wrong token
tests.description: Lock the server, then try to unlock with a different token.

categories.name: Structured Logging
categories.description: ServerLogProvider feature: structured log queries with filters

tests.name: GetLogs with no filters returns entries
tests.description: Query logs with no filters. Server should have logged startup entries.
tests.expected: Non-empty array of log entries returned

tests.name: GetLogs with MinSeverity=ERROR
tests.description: Query logs filtered to ERROR and above. All returned entries should be ERROR or CRITICAL.
tests.expected: All entries have level ERROR or CRITICAL (or empty if none)

tests.name: GetLogs with Feature=Server
tests.description: Query logs filtered to a specific feature. Verifies Feature filter works.
tests.expected: All returned entries are from the Server feature

tests.name: MaxEntries parameter limits output
tests.description: Request logs with MaxEntries=3. Should return at most 3 entries.

tests.name: ClearLogs empties log database
tests.description: Clear all logs, then verify GetLogs returns empty (or only new startup entries).
tests.expected: After clear, log count is reset

tests.name: GetLogFeatures returns feature list
tests.description: GetLogFeatures should return a list containing at least 'Server' (from startup logs).

categories.name: Script Runner — Execution
categories.description: Core script execution: output capture, exit codes, error handling, and the device helper preamble

tests.name: Simple print output
tests.description: Run a one-liner that prints 'hello' and verify it appears in FullOutput with exit code 0.

tests.name: Multi-line output
tests.description: Run a script with multiple print statements and verify all lines appear in FullOutput.

tests.name: Computation and formatted output
tests.description: Run a script that does arithmetic and string formatting, verify computed result in output.

tests.name: Standard library imports
tests.description: Verify scripts can import standard library modules (json, math, datetime).

params.ScriptCode:
import json, math, datetime
print('imports_ok')
print(json.dumps({'pi': round(math.pi, 2)}))

tests.name: Loop output
tests.description: Run a script with a for loop and verify output from each iteration.

tests.name: Syntax error produces non-zero exit code
tests.description: Run code with a syntax error. Should complete (not crash the server) with non-zero exit code and traceback in output.

tests.name: Runtime exception produces non-zero exit code
tests.description: Run code that raises a runtime exception. Should produce non-zero exit code with traceback.

tests.name: Empty script succeeds with exit code 0
tests.description: Run an empty (whitespace-only) script. Should succeed without error.

tests.name: FullOutput contains ScriptRunner banner
tests.description: Verify that ScriptRunner injects its own [ScriptRunner] Started and Finished banners into the output.

tests.name: Consecutive script executions
tests.description: Run two scripts back-to-back. Verify each produces independent output (no bleed-over).
tests.expected: First output contains 'first_run', second contains 'second_run' and not 'first_run'

categories.name: Script Runner — Device Helper
categories.description: Verify the injected `device` helper object works: introspection, print, sleep

tests.name: device object is available
tests.description: Verify the `device` object exists and is a DeviceHelper instance.

tests.name: device.print() writes to output
tests.description: Verify device.print() sends text to the captured output stream.

tests.name: device.features lists server features
tests.description: Verify device.features returns a list that includes XArm6Controller and ScriptRunner.

tests.name: device.commands() lists feature commands
tests.description: Verify device.commands('ScriptRunner') returns known command names.

tests.name: device.properties() lists feature properties
tests.description: Verify device.properties('ScriptRunner') returns IsRunning.

tests.name: device.property() reads a SiLA property
tests.description: Use device.property() to read the DeviceDescription property (string). Should not crash.

tests.name: device.command() calls SiLA command (simulation)
tests.description: Use device.command() to call Connect in simulation mode and verify the response.

params.ScriptCode:
import json
result = device.command('XArm6Controller', 'Connect', IpAddress='SIM')
print(json.dumps(result))

categories.name: Script Runner — Persistence
categories.description: Save, load, list, delete, and overwrite scripts stored on the server

tests.name: Full CRUD round-trip
tests.description: Save a script, verify it appears in list, load it back, then delete it and verify it's gone.
tests.expected: Save/list/load/delete all succeed, code matches after load, gone after delete

tests.name: SaveScript overwrites existing
tests.description: Save a script, save it again with different code, verify it's overwritten.

tests.name: LoadScript of non-existent script
tests.description: Try to load a script that doesn't exist. Should return an error.

tests.name: DeleteScript of non-existent script
tests.description: Try to delete a script that doesn't exist. Should return an error.

tests.name: ListScripts when no scripts saved
tests.description: List scripts after deleting all saved ones. Should return empty list or only built-in scripts.
tests.expected: ScriptNames is empty or contains only built-in scripts

tests.name: Save and load multi-line script
tests.description: Save a script with multiple lines including loops and conditionals, then load it back.

tests.name: Save script with special characters
tests.description: Save a script with quotes, backslashes, and other special characters. Verify it loads correctly.

categories.name: Script Runner — Error Handling
categories.description: Script execution error scenarios: timeouts, concurrent runs, resource limits

tests.name: Concurrent RunScript attempts
tests.description: Start a long-running script, then try to start another while the first is still running. Should reject the second.
tests.expected: Second RunScript returns error (script already running)

tests.name: SaveScript while script is running
tests.description: Run a script, then try to save a script while it's executing. Should succeed (save is independent).

tests.name: Infinite loop script
tests.description: Run a script with an infinite loop. Verify it can be stopped (manually or via timeout if implemented).
tests.expected: Script runs indefinitely or times out gracefully

tests.name: Import non-existent module
tests.description: Try to import a module that doesn't exist. Should produce ModuleNotFoundError with non-zero exit code.

tests.name: Large output script
tests.description: Run a script that produces a large amount of output. Verify it completes without truncation errors.

tests.name: Unicode characters in output
tests.description: Run a script that prints Unicode characters (emoji, non-ASCII). Verify they're captured correctly.
